summary: Frontend-only testing of 'Petualangan Angka' Expo/React Native app on web preview with localStorage-backed DB fallback. Executed 27 total assertions across 2 Playwright runs covering all requested behaviors. All assertions passed. Verified: player add/duplicate rejection, data separation between players, Beranda selectors + disabled start, practice game question correctness (parsed expressions matched correct option), 4 unique options with exactly one correct, challenge timer counting + score +10/correct, result screen, abandoned challenge not ranked, completed challenge appearing in highscore with active-player highlight, scope + operation + difficulty filters, practice-only session NOT ranked in highscore, persistence/progress accumulation. No red screens, no console errors, no deprecated expo packages (expo-sqlite is current), SafeAreaView used via react-native-safe-area-context, all text wrapped in <Text>.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Beranda resets selected mode to 'practice' on remount (useState default) after returning from Result; this is UX by design but could reset accidentally after result-play-again workflow transitions. Current behavior is acceptable because result-play-again uses router.replace with explicit params.
Minor: BackHandler sets finishedRef=true on hardware back but DOES NOT save a session — correct per spec (abandoned not ranked). Confirmed via UI exit-button flow in test (no row created).
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage seeding for pa_web_players and pa_web_sessions to exercise highscore and data-separation scenarios efficiently. Also verified end-to-end flow by playing a real challenge with Date.now time-travel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is offline-first; on web preview it uses database.web.ts (localStorage). Use localStorage seeding to speed up tests. Timer uses Date.now() wall clock, so you can override window.Date.now to end the 60s challenge instantly. Bottom tab labels (Beranda/Highscore/Pemain) each appear twice in the DOM (once as tab, once as link/body text), so use .nth(count-1) or testIDs when navigating.
